svg.aria-label: 16 GPUs on 2 nodes: pipeline stage per node; inside a node, attention uses TP 2 x CP 2 x DP 2 and the MoE layer uses EP 4 x EDP 2; the token contract on g2 is sent to experts on g1 and g3.
svg.text: One MoE training step on 16 GPUs
4 layers · 8 experts (top-2) · 4 sentences × 8 tokens · world = PP 2 × 8 GPUs per node
MoE view of the same GPUs: ETP 1 × EP 4 × EDP 2 = 8
g1 ↔ g5: same weights and experts, different sentences → average gradients (DP, EDP)
CP: split the sentence, pass K/V
PP: hand off to the next stage
